tips.title: Tips for Arabic captions
tips.hashtags: Join the words of an Arabic hashtag with underscores, for example #عروض_اليوم.
tips.fold: Put the key information first: Instagram hides everything after the first few lines behind "more".
tips.images: Text inside images is not translated by this tool. Prepare Arabic images separately.
tips.emoji: Place emoji at the end of a sentence or clause so they do not jump around in Arabic text.
tips.mixing: Avoid switching between Arabic and English in the middle of a sentence. Put each language in its own paragraph.
